summary.text: Jeff Shawan is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 152 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Corretta Bishop for an open seat.
Shawan previously represented District 153 in the Missouri House from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Shawan won election to the Missouri House of Representatives from District 153 in 2018, defeating Democrat Matt Michel 74.5 percent to 25.5 percent.

He assumed office in 2019 and left office on January 6, 2021, and in 2019 and 2020 he was assigned to the House Economic Development, General Laws, Higher Education, and Professional Registration and Licensing committees.

Shawan did not run for re-election to the House in 2020; he instead sought the Republican nomination for Missouri State Senate District 25, finishing second with 20.8 percent of the primary vote behind Jason Bean.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 152.
